title: Growth Regulators in Blueberries: Keys to Firmness and Quality
metaDescription: Learn how growth regulators and application timing influence blueberry firmness and quality, according to experts.
excerpt: Experts analyze the impact of growth regulators on blueberries, highlighting how application timing and variety determine fruit quality.
imageAlt: Fresh and wild blueberries on a plant ready to be harvested in the field.

blocks.text: During the XLIII International Berry Seminar Morocco 2026, Reinaldo Campos, director of the Department of Agricultural Production at the University of Chile, spoke about the importance of using pre-harvest growth regulators. His presentation delved into how these agronomic tools aim to improve specific fruit attributes, stressing that the success of the treatments is closely tied to the plant variety and the timing at which they are applied.
The presentation detailed several fundamental aspects for understanding how fruit responds to this type of management:

items: Fruit caliber and size were evaluated together with the use of cytokinins as part of the management goals.
The importance of split applications and the different crop phases was highlighted when analyzing when to intervene.
Gibberellic acid was directly linked to blueberry firmness, a determining factor for its commercial performance.
Post-harvest variables such as temperature, vapor pressure deficit and water loss directly influence fruit preservation.

blocks.text: For growers in the region, connecting decisions made at the pre-harvest stage with the final condition of the fruit is a constant challenge. The study reminds us that factors such as available technology and distance to market set the tone for how fruit should be handled after harvest, making sure blueberries keep their quality standards until they reach their final destination.

Technical rigor at every stage of growing is what makes it possible to get firm, good-quality fruit. At Fresh Pick we apply it on our high-mountain farm in Guasca, where we hand-pick every blueberry at its optimal ripeness.
